description: PS1 homebrew candidates for plugin-lab validation (Issue #6). Binaries are NOT stored in VCS: fetch with scripts/fetch_homebrew.py and verify SHA-256. Only permissively licensed games are accepted. Boot gate: unpatched homebrew discs boot-loop inside the OpenBIOS shell (license-sector requirement) — produce local license-patched images with scripts/make_homebrew_lic.py using the user's own retail disc; patched images are local-only and never committed.
boot_gate_finding: 2026-10-22 OBSERVED: without license sectors (0..15) the OpenBIOS shello CDChecker loops forever (identical cube animation across Tetrade/Nortis/PSXMC; game EXE never reaches RAM, ~72KB nonzero). Copying the 16 license sectors from the user's own MSX disc into a LOCAL copy unblocks boot for all three (RAM 72KB->555KB, game strings/EXE load, padbuff fills with 00 41 ff ff, buttons deliver). This SUPERSEDES the earlier 'OpenBIOS kernel pad defect' diagnosis on the beetle backend: padbuff absence was a symptom of the game never running, not a pad-path defect. PCSX-Redux-side observation is stale pending re-test under the same fix.

accepted.status: ACCEPTED+TESTED 2026-10-22: BOOTED, INPUT_RESPONSIVE (START title->menu; padbuff 00 41 ff ff at 0xBB120/0xBB142), STATE_CHANGE_CONFIRMED, GAMEPLAY_CONFIRMED (CROSS -> Marathon mode, piece moves with LEFT/RIGHT) through the shared beetle core + OpenBIOS with the LOCAL license-patched image. Unpatched release disc boot-loops (see boot_gate_finding).
